answer: Seed honeypots whose right answer is known to be wrong. Any identity that approves one is marked, and the panel resets the moment an identity link appears. Auditors rotate from a pool too large to buy. A farmer can dodge a single trap, not one planted in every batch. The oasis is a clean payout after passing; the reef is a bad item hidden among good ones; the meadow is the ordinary queue nobody inspects twice. Price: solving a task you cannot verify, with a rotating jury you cannot pre-pay, and one wrong approval that voids the stake behind every linked alias.
